query:
UPDATE ai_subscriptions
            SET provider = $3,
                plan = $4,
                monthly_cost = $5::int8 / 100.0,
                currency = $6,
                valid_from = $7,
                valid_to = $8,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE id = $1
              AND ($2::int4 IS NULL OR user_id = $2)
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                provider,
                plan,
                (monthly_cost * 100)::int8 AS "monthly_cost_hundredths!",
                currency,
                valid_from,
                valid_to
